claims: Sean Penn has won three Academy Awards from six nominations.
Sean Penn won Best Actor for Mystic River (2004) as Jimmy Markum.
Sean Penn won Best Actor for Milk (2009) as Harvey Milk.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another (2026) as Col. Steven J. Lockjaw.
Sean Penn won his third Oscar for his role in Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another.
Sean Penn did not attend the 2026 Oscars ceremony.
Kieran Culkin accepted Sean Penn's Oscar on his behalf at the 2026 Oscars.
Sean Penn joined Jack Nicholson, Daniel Day-Lewis, and Walter Brennan as one of the few male actors to win three acting Oscars with his third win in 2026.
Sean Penn was nominated for Best Actor for Dead Man Walking (1996).
Sean Penn was nominated for Best Actor for Sweet and Lowdown (2000).
Sean Penn was nominated for Best Actor for I Am Sam (2002).
